name: izero
description: Local-first cognitive memory for Codex. Remembers decisions, patterns, and preferences across sessions — no cloud, no API key, offline ONNX embeddings.

interface.shortDescription: Local-first cognitive memory layer for AI coding workflows
interface.longDescription: izero adds long-term, decaying, consolidated memory to Codex. Store decisions, user preferences, project context, and session state across conversations. Memories are retrieved via local hybrid search (vector + BM25 + entity graph) so Codex always has the right context — without any network call. The store lives at ~/.isotope_zero/, works offline, and needs no API key.
defaultPrompt: Search my memories for recent project decisions
Remember that I prefer spaces over tabs
What do you know about my coding preferences?
